trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (mean on pool3) and the runner-up margin is 0.00284 with an "indistinguishable" verdict. Per the stopping rules, when the leader is a seed and the verdict is indistinguishable, accepting is the right call. action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.985) with moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.571) and only 3 validation windows. The mean over pool3 (9 most consistent models) already includes the top CWT_catboost and DWT_catboost variants that dominate the error table, while excluding the 11 weaker models (median error 25.4 vs 7.5 for the best). The runner-up is statistically indistinguishable (margin 0.0028), and with only 3 windows, more complex weighting or subset selection would risk overfitting to noise rather than capturing a real signal.
